text: {"findings":[{"rule":"H3","where":"Token.forcedTransfer (also used by Token.recoveryAddress)","severity":"MEDIUM","why":"forcedTransfer moves balances but never calls _tokenCompliance.transferred. MaxBalanceModule's _IDBalance for the sender and receiver identities therefore stops matching real balances. The receiver's recorded balance is too low, so it can later exceed the 1000 cap (H1). The sender's recorded balance is too high, and the receiver's own later transfers can revert on underflow in moduleTransferAction.","steps":"1) Mint 1000 to b. 2) Agent calls forcedTransfer(b, a1, 1000); the real balance of a1 is 1000 but _IDBalance[idA] stays 0 and _IDBalance[idB] stays 1000. 3) Mint or transfer another 1000 to a1; moduleCheck passes because it sees 0, so idA holds 2000. 4) a1 transfers tokens out, which can underflow or misreport in moduleTransferAction."}]}
